Add a fail-closed runtime handle/probe surface without exposing P3-002 browser sessions/actions. ProductRuntime close must terminate any active browser probe/runtime cleanly, and unavailable/missing bundles must remain honest rather than falling back to global tools.
requiredTests: ProductRuntime exposes P3 browser bundle/probe availability without implementing P3-002
missing/invalid P3 bundle fails closed with bounded status
ProductRuntime close terminates P3 runtime resources
no global Node/browser fallback is introduced
